title: AXI Same-ID Read Response Order
description: Two two-beat reads use ID 0; inspect the accepted AR requests and RLAST completions to see why response A must remain ahead of response B.

annotations.message: Read A is accepted first with ARID 0.
Read B is accepted next with the same ARID 0. The interface now has a per-ID issue queue A → B.
The first R beat belongs to A. Returning B first would violate same-ID read response ordering.
A completes when its second beat transfers with RLAST=1. Only now can B's response begin.
B begins after A has fully completed, even if B's target data happened to become available earlier.
B completes with its own RLAST. The repeated RID is disambiguated by issue order within the ID 0 queue.
